sbar.situation: The bank payment journey has recovered. Two recovery looks ran, and the last one at 21 s was clean (2 of 2 in a row).
sbar.background: Fraud screening primary slowed to p95 1817 ms (baseline 15 ms) against the 1.0 s caller timeout, so every payment failed with 503. About 10 s before, an operator raised the gateway setting balance_cache_ttl_s from 0.5 to 600.0.
sbar.assessment: Screening's slow primary was the main cause (confidence 0.9); the incident commander failed screening over to its standby, and screening is now served by the standby. The gateway balance cache TTL change was a hidden second fault that would stop posted payments showing in balances (confidence 0.75); the incident commander reverted balance_cache_ttl_s from 600.0 to 0.5.
sbar.recommendation: Investigate why the screening primary slowed, since it had no change event, and keep traffic on the standby until it is fixed. Ask the operator why balance_cache_ttl_s was raised. Operations should review the payments that failed with 503 during the outage, and any balances read while the 600 s TTL was set.
